from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentDocument(BaseModel):
    document_title: str | None = Field(description="The title or identifier of the judgment document (e.g., '判决文书 15')")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The case cause of action (案由) described in the document text")
    case_nature: str | None = Field(description="The general legal nature of the case as stated (e.g., '行政', '民事')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    judgment_documents: list[JudgmentDocument]
